seo.title: Free Online Breastfeeding Timer — Left & Right
seo.description: A free breastfeeding timer for the left and right side. Switch sides, pause, fix a late start and see today’s feeds. Private to your browser, no sign-up.

how.heading: How this timer works
how.body: A free breastfeeding timer for the left and right side that works in your browser. There’s nothing to install and no account to make.

steps.title: Choose a side
steps.body: Tap Left or Right. The side you finished on last time is marked Last used.

steps.title: Start, switch and pause
steps.body: Switch sides without stopping, and pause for a burp or a nappy change. Lock your phone or close the tab and the timer carries on.

steps.title: Stop to save
steps.body: Each feed is saved with the time on each side. Open History to see today’s feeds, or tap + to add one you missed.

privacy.heading: Private to this device
privacy.body: Your feeds are saved in this browser on this device. They aren’t uploaded anywhere, and clearing your browsing data deletes them.

app.heading: Carry on in the iPhone app
app.body: Everything this timer does, with more of what helps when you’re feeding around the clock.

faqs.question: Is this breastfeeding timer free?
faqs.answer: Yes. There’s nothing to sign up for and nothing to install.

faqs.question: Do I need to keep this page open?
faqs.answer: No. The timer counts from the moment you tapped Start, so you can lock your phone or close the tab and pick up where you left off in the same browser.

faqs.question: Where are my feeds saved?
faqs.answer: In this browser on this device. Open this page in the same browser to see them again. Private browsing and clearing your browsing data remove them.

faqs.question: I forgot to press Start. Can I fix the time?
faqs.answer: Yes. While the timer runs, tap Started at and set the time the feed really began. For a feed you didn’t time at all, tap + and add it.

faqs.question: Does it time pumping or bottle feeds?
faqs.answer: This page times breastfeeds. The iPhone app also logs bottles and pumping, and keeps track of your milk stash.

footer.note: This timer records what you enter. It isn’t medical advice. If you’re worried about feeding, talk to your midwife, health visitor or GP.
